messages:
Amelia: Quick sync — want to lock the SI certification roadmap so we can onboard 3 hardware partners + Marketplace SI partners by Q3. Key asks: exam, hands-on lab, partner badge. Who's in?
Raghav: I'm in. Draft modules: platform basics, deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), security & networking, performance tuning, cost ops. Planning 4 self-study modules + 1 proctored lab.
Sofia: +1. Recommend we include a 60-90m hands-on lab with a sample private deploy (VPC) and mini-eval. I can build lab playbook if we agree scope.
Tom: What's the criteria to issue a badge? Passing score? Lab completion? customer-facing demo?
Amelia: Proposed badge rules: pass written (>=80%), complete lab run (submit logs + basic eval), one recorded demo (10m). Also optional marketplace listing enablement review. See runbook draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/si-cert-runbook
Raghav: Also add HW partner matrix: list of validated GPUs + quantization notes. Could be a short appendix.
Sofia: I can pilot with Orbita and EdgeWave week of May 6. Will need access to their infra creds + 2 devs each.
Tom: Heads-up: for enterprise SIs we should offer a Train-the-Trainer session. 2-day remote workshop.
Amelia: Good call. Add "TTT" as an add-on. Budget for vendor credits? Partnerships can cover minimal dev hours for pilots.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created by Amelia for "SI Cert Roadmap Sync" on 2024-05-01 10:00 PT
Raghav: I'll assemble evaluation rubric this week. Will share checklist in #si-cert once ready.
Sofia: Can someone create a permanent space in the partner portal w/ materials? I want controlled access for exam creds.
Amelia: I'll follow up with product for a portal release ticket. Meanwhile, Raghav + Sofia, send me your pilot runbook by Friday.
Tom: 👍 I'll loop in two SIs and flag any legal requirements for NDAs.
Amelia: Great — thanks team. We'll aim to finalize criteria + pilot plan by next Friday. :rocket:
